maya: Morning team — quick async standup for GPU fleet.
maya: What I did: rebalanced ams1 pool and freed 4x A100 slots (moved low-priority batches), verified node health.
maya: Blockers: seeing sporadic OOMs from longgen jobs, they spike at ~step 1200 and sometimes kill the job. Haven't reproduced locally.
maya: Today: triaging logs, running a local repro, and coordinating routing if ams2 quota is flaky. @sam can you confirm ams2 quota status?

sam: I bumped ams2 spot quota by +20 yesterday (request approved). Billing tags still need cleanup — want to avoid unexpected spend if we fallback there.
sam: Can you paste a job id for the OOMs?

maya: Job id: run_2026_03_17_longgen_42
maya: Log snippet:
```text
OOM on gpu 2 at step 1200
alloc failed: 1.2GB
stack: kv_cache_alloc -> attention_buf -> allocate
```

ops-bot: Alert — node ams1-n42 reported GPU memory error 03:11 UTC. Incident# INC-8247

leo: I looked through the logs — kv cache isn't evicting aggressively for very long contexts. Suggest enabling prefix cache trim on the service; that helped in a similar case.
leo: Proposed env tweak: `CACHE_PREFIX_TRIM=true` and reduce `KV_CACHE_MAX_BYTES` by 10%.

arjun: Heads up — provider maintenance on ams2 tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC, they warned of soft limits for some instance types. Could cause temporary capacity dips.

sam: noted. If maintenance triggers, we need automatic fallback routing to ams1-dedicated. Also I'll clean up billing tags by EOD.

jen: Confirmed routing policies include a fallback path for G4->A100 variants. I'll keep canary ready and bump fallback weighting if we detect increased failures.
jen: Will also add an alert to watch for sustained retry rates >5%.

zach: No blockers; finished the capacity forecast sheet and uploaded it: https://drive.redwood/reports/2026-q1-prewarm
zach: Forecast shows ams1 margin falls to ~8% during peak if we don't shift some batch traffic.

maya: Action items: leo to open small PR to add prefix-trim toggle, sam to finalize billing tags, jen to watch fallback and be ready to flip weights, zach to update forecast if we shift batches. I'll continue triage and post a short follow-up if OOM reproduces.

maya: Thanks all — ping here if you want me to pause any scheduled batch runs. :thumbsup:
